name: cross-model-agent-delegation
description: Deterministic delegation between Claude Code and the Codex CLI in both directions, plus Gemini 4 Argon from Claude Code. Install the half that matches the CLI you drive, or both.

plugins.name: cross-model-delegation
plugins.description: Install in Claude Code. Routes worker tasks out to the Codex CLI (GPT-6 Astra, Sol, Luna) and to Gemini 4 Argon through the Antigravity CLI, and runs a second Claude login side by side.

plugins.name: delegate-to-claude
plugins.description: Install in Codex. Routes worker tasks out to the Claude Code CLI (Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5).
